description: Podcast episode archive — previewUrl, releaseDate, explicit, cursor pagination (flat 2 credits). Costs 2 credits. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh. Envelope includes cached + cachedAt on hits.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor. Leave empty for the first page; then pass the nextCursor value returned in the previous response.

limit.description: Max items to return (default 20, max 50). Flat 2 credits per call.

raw.description: Include slimmed per-episode upstream payload as episodes[].raw. Default false. visualIdentity / playedState / podcastV2 are never included.

url.description: Spotify show/podcast URL, URI, or ID (e.g. https://open.spotify.com/show/…). Not an artist URL.

name: spotify_podcast_episodes
title: Spotify Podcast Episodes
